name: Acceptance
source: In “Acceptance,” the narrative follows a young man who is struggling to find his identity after discovering his tenants in a compromising situation. He faces challenges in reconciling his sexuality and must come to terms with his inner self in order to support those around him. love, lust, and kink: are these three concepts intertwined?
translation: 在《接纳》中，故事围绕一名年轻男子展开：在无意撞见自家房客们尴尬香艳的私密一幕后，他陷入了对自我身份认同的迷茫挣扎。为了能坦然支持身边的人，他必须直面自身性取向的困惑，与内心真实的自我达成和解。爱意、情欲与性癖——这三者究竟是否彼此交织、密不可分？
